label: v1-dense-baseline
notes: groundedness measured 2026-08-24 after BLOCKERS #11 was fixed (ae14943). The earlier run died on question 45 (first Tamil) at ~10.4k prompt tokens; context is now trimmed to generate.max_prompt_tokens=6000. 12 of 54 questions were trimmed. Retrieval metrics are unchanged by the fix, as expected - it touches generation only.
recall@20 == recall@10 exactly: retrieving deeper than 10 adds nothing, so rerank may use top_n 10 for free.
rank distribution of the correct chunk over 49 answerable: rank1=30, rank2-5=14, rank6-10=4, rank11-20=0, never=1.
a perfect reranker over top-20 therefore caps at recall@5 = 0.980, i.e. +0.082 headroom on the gating metric.
